title: Health aggregator isolates hanging checks and reports worst status
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag that a timed-out thread keeps running. The threads are daemons by design: the contract is that a hanging check degrades only its own entry and the report still returns promptly; abandoning the thread is the isolation mechanism, not a leak the caller must join.
